3. **Compare each demonstration cellwise.** Align input and output by row and column. Record every changed coordinate and its before/after color; separately note unchanged cells and any dimension/color-count changes. Do not infer a rule from the input alone.
4. **Generate compact candidate rules.** Ask what determines changed cells: local pattern, component shape, repetition, position, count, parity, symmetry, or relation to another object. Prefer a simple rule accounting for changed and unchanged instances.
